Operations.Name: IscsiTargetextentCreate
Operations.Description:
Create an Associated Target.

`lunid` will be automatically assigned if it is not provided based on the `target`.

Arguments.Name: iscsi_target_to_extent_create
Arguments.Description: Target-to-extent association configuration data for creation.

Arguments.Name: id
Arguments.Description: ID of the target-to-extent association to delete.

Arguments.Name: force
Arguments.Description: Whether to force deletion even if the association is in use.
